claims: Rick Barnes is the head coach of the Tennessee Volunteers men's basketball team.
Rick Barnes has held the position of head coach of the Tennessee Volunteers men's basketball team since 2015.
As of March 2026, Rick Barnes is the winningest active coach in NCAA Division I men's basketball.
As of March 2026, Rick Barnes has led the Tennessee Volunteers to a program-record eight consecutive NCAA Tournament appearances.
As of March 2026, Rick Barnes is in his 11th season at Tennessee.
Rick Barnes led Tennessee to multiple Sweet 16s.
Rick Barnes led Tennessee to back-to-back Elite Eight appearances.
Rick Barnes holds the program record with 13 NCAA Tournament wins.
Rick Barnes previously coached at George Mason.
Rick Barnes previously coached at Providence.
Rick Barnes previously coached at Clemson.
Rick Barnes previously coached at Texas.
Kim Caldwell is the head coach of the Tennessee Lady Volunteers as of the 2025-26 season.
Bruce Pearl was a previous men's coach from 2005 to 2011.
Ray Mears was a former men's coach.
